# SingleStepTests 80286 real-mode MOO test suites (pinned acquisition)
#
# Pinned source:
#   repo:  https://github.com/SingleStepTests/80286
#   commit: 37c73caf53dcd22d3dd369ff09305d13d117a4fe (refs/heads/main)
#   suite:  v1.1.0 real-mode (see CHANGELOG.md at the pinned commit)
#
# Hash semantics:
#   Each line is: <NAME> <SHA256-OF-DECOMPRESSED-MOO>
#   The hash is the sha256 of the DECOMPRESSED .MOO file (the raw MOO
#   binary test suite), NOT of the .MOO.gz blob as stored upstream.
#
# How to add an entry:
#   1. Download ${RAW_BASE}/${NAME}.MOO.gz at the pinned commit.
#   2. gunzip it and compute: sha256sum <NAME>.MOO
#   3. Append "<NAME> <that-hash>" to this manifest.
#   4. Place the decompressed <NAME>.MOO under dis86/data/sst/full/
#      (full/ is gitignored; only the manifest is tracked).
#
# Micro corpus (dis86/data/sst/micro/) is tracked directly in git and is
# populated by a later phase; it is intentionally absent here.
#
# Auxiliary pinned files also fetched into full/ (not hashed here):
#   revocation_list.txt  - SHA1 revocation list from the pinned commit
#   CHANGELOG.md         - suite changelog from the pinned commit
#
